passages.title: A Saturday Morning of Family House Cleaning
passages.text: Keeping a home tidy and hygienic requires regular effort and teamwork from every family member. Every Saturday morning, our entire household gathers to begin our routine house cleaning. First, my father collects all empty food containers, paper wrappings, and kitchen waste to prepare the garbage for curbside collection. Proper waste disposal and regular trash removal keep our living spaces fresh and free from unpleasant odors. Meanwhile, my mother heads to the laundry area to organize our weekly washing. She sorts dark clothes from whites and adds mild detergent into the machine to wash everyday shirts and bed linens. After the cycle finishes, she proudly hangs each freshly washed garment on outdoor lines where warm morning sunlight dries them quickly. Inside the bathroom, my brother fills a large plastic bucket with warm water and natural floor soap. He uses a stiff scrub brush to remove soap scum from ceramic tiles and bathroom corners. After scrubbing, he dries the wet tiles with an absorbent cotton towel so no slippery spots remain on the floor. At the same time, I grab a soft microfiber cloth and gently wipe dust off bookshelves, window sills, and living room tables. We find that working together makes household chores feel enjoyable rather than exhausting. By noon, the whole house smells wonderfully fresh, polished wooden surfaces shine, and every room feels comfortable and welcoming. Sharing everyday cleaning duties teaches children personal responsibility and creates a harmonious, tidy home environment. Sitting together on clean sofas after finishing our work brings a satisfying sense of accomplishment. We enjoy a cool glass of lemonade, knowing our living space is thoroughly sanitized and ready for a relaxing weekend. Maintaining order through small daily habits ensures that our home remains a peaceful sanctuary.

passages.title: Sharing Household Responsibilities: Organizing Chores and Maintaining a Pristine Home
passages.titleVi: Chia sẻ trách nhiệm gia đình: Sắp xếp việc nhà và giữ gìn tổ ấm tinh tươm
passages.text: Maintaining a healthy, comfortable, and orderly living environment requires consistent dedication to daily housework from every family member. On bright Saturday mornings, cooperative parents and energetic children gather in the kitchen to divide essential cleaning chores fairly across the entire household. Someone fills a sturdy plastic bucket with warm water and fragrant liquid soap, while another grabs a damp microfiber cloth to wipe accumulated dust from wooden bookshelves and wide windowsills. In the kitchen, siblings wash greasy breakfast plates and use a soapy textured sponge to scrub countertop stains thoroughly until kitchen surfaces sparkle. After carefully rinsing the dishes under running tap water, they dry each delicate glass with a clean cotton towel and stack ceramic plates neatly inside the kitchen cupboards. Meanwhile, older teenagers carry a stiff bristled scrub brush and eco-friendly cleanser to deep clean bathroom floor tiles and sanitize the bathtub. Rather than letting discarded cardboard packaging and junk accumulate into an unsightly mess, family members sort recyclables into designated bins and properly dispose of all household garbage outdoors. In the sunny laundry room, clothes are separated by fabric color, washed thoroughly to cleanse everyday sweat and odors, and hung neatly on drying racks to air dry in the warm breeze. In addition, sweeping the outdoor entryway and watering porch flowerbeds adds a welcoming touch of beauty to the home exterior. Dividing regular housework among family members turns potentially tiring chores into an engaging collaborative effort that teaches children personal responsibility and lifelong organizational discipline. When every room is spotless, tidy, and smelling fresh, everyone enjoys a well-deserved sense of satisfaction and mutual accomplishment. Ultimately, sharing everyday household chores strengthens family bonds, fosters cooperative teamwork, and transforms an ordinary living space into a truly welcoming, peaceful haven.

passages.text: Maintaining a clean and hygienic domestic environment brings peace of mind and revitalizes the entire family after busy working days. Establishing regular routines prevents household clutter from accumulating into overwhelming chaos. On Saturday mornings, family members divide routine housework to complete the weekend cleanup quickly and cheerfully. The first essential step involves grabbing a sturdy straw broom to sweep fallen crumbs, pet hair, and loose debris from the kitchen tile floor. Afterward, someone fills a plastic bucket with warm water and fragrant liquid soap to mop away stubborn sticky spots. While floors dry naturally in the gentle breeze, another helper takes a damp microfiber cloth to wipe accumulated dust off wooden bookshelves and window sills. In the kitchen, using a durable sponge alongside warm water helps rinse greasy frying pans until they shine brightly again. It is equally important to sort discarded household packaging properly, separating plastic containers for recycling before placing remaining garbage into the outdoor bin. Once surfaces are sanitized, everyone works together to fold fresh laundry and arrange children toys neatly inside labeled storage cubbies. Furthermore, playing cheerful background music turns repetitive cleaning chores into a fun communal bonding ritual rather than a dreaded obligation. Even young children can participate happily by sorting socks or watering potted balcony plants. Keeping rooms well organized and tidy transforms any residence into a welcoming sanctuary where family members feel truly comfortable. Psychological studies confirm that decluttering living quarters reduces daily anxiety and dramatically improves focus during study or remote office work. By sharing simple chores cooperatively and respecting communal spaces, families create healthy household habits that endure for years to come.

passages.title: A Calm Twenty-Minute Evening Kitchen Reset
passages.text:
Waking up to a clean, bright kitchen sink makes making morning coffee feel calm instead of stressful. Rather than saving heavy scrubbing for exhausted Sunday afternoons, try spending just twenty focused minutes resetting the kitchen every single night right after dinner. Following the same simple top-to-bottom order quickly turns an annoying daily chore into an easy evening wind-down routine.

Begin by putting away leftover food cleanly into clear glass boxes and returning spices, olive oil, and salt jars to their proper cabinet shelves. Scrape food scraps directly into your compost bin or trash bag, then stack dirty pots and plates neatly on one side of the sink so soapy dishwater has plenty of open room. Soaking sticky frying pans with warm water and two drops of mild dish soap saves hard elbow scrubbing later.

While pans soak quietly for five minutes, spray countertops, wooden cutting boards, and the stove top with a gentle kitchen cleaner and wipe everything dry with a clean microfiber cloth. Always clean flat counters and dining tables first before wiping down the sink basin, keeping crumbs off freshly washed dishes. Next, rinse plates, utensils, and mugs cleanly, setting them neatly inside a drying rack beside the faucet.

Finally, sweep stray flour or crumbs off the kitchen floor around the stove, hang damp dish towels neatly to dry overnight, and run the dishwasher cycle if needed. Stepping into a tidy, fresh kitchen at seven o clock the next morning rewards your small nightly effort ten times over.

passages.title: A Weekend Deep-Clean Checklist That Prevents Stubborn Grime
passages.text:
Saturday cleaning often turns exhausting when sticky kitchen grime, dusty window tracks, and bathroom soap buildup wait all month for one giant marathon session. Two roommates named Linh and Hannah changed that frustrating cycle by splitting deep chores into three short twenty-minute zones every Saturday morning right after breakfast. Because nothing piles up long enough to harden, their shared apartment stays spotless without wasting an entire sunny afternoon indoors.

First, Hannah starts in the kitchen with a bucket of lukewarm soapy water and two clean microfiber cloths. She wipes down stove handles, cabinet doors, and vent filters before greasy cooking vapor settles onto painted wood or causes range fans overheating from thick dust. Next, she sprays gentle vinegar solution across each glass pane and wipes straight across with a dry towel so streaks never catch afternoon sunlight.

Meanwhile, Linh focuses on high-touch hallway switches, desk fans, and bathroom tiles. Rather than spraying harsh chemicals straight onto stone edges, she rinses ceramic shelves with warm water, scrubs corners gently using an old soft brush, polishes chrome sink faucets dry, and empties small trash bins before stale odors drift outward. Finally, both roommates run a quick broom sweep along wooden baseboards, shake entrance mats outside on the balcony, and wash their damp sponges before lunch.

By finishing small cleaning zones steadily every weekend, neither roommate ever faces stubborn buildup, wasted daylight, or exhausting Sunday burnout. A simple shared checklist turns tiring weekly housework into an easy, predictable habit that keeps every bright room fresh and welcoming.

Nhờ không có vết bẩn nào kịp tích tụ lâu để đóng cứng, căn hộ chung của họ luôn sạch bong mà không lãng phí cả buổi chiều nắng đẹp trong nhà.

Đầu tiên, Hannah bắt đầu ở khu bếp với một xô nước xà phòng âm ấm và hai chiếc khăn sợi nhỏ sạch. Cô lau núm bếp, cánh tủ và lưới lọc mùi trước khi hơi dầu mỡ bám lên bề mặt gỗ sơn hoặc khiến quạt hút bị quá nhiệt do bụi dày. Tiếp đó, cô xịt dung dịch giấm dịu nhẹ lên từng ô kính cửa sổ rồi lau thẳng bằng khăn khô để vệt loang không bao giờ hiện lên dưới nắng chiều.

Trong lúc đó, Linh phụ trách các công tắc hành lang hay chạm tay, quạt bàn và gạch ốp phòng tắm. Thay vì xịt thẳng hóa chất mạnh lên mép đá, cô dội nước ấm lên kệ sứ, chà nhẹ các góc bằng bàn chải lông mềm cũ, lau khô bóng vòi bồn rửa mạ crôm và đổ thùng rác nhỏ trước khi mùi ẩm mốc lan ra. Cuối cùng, cả hai cùng quét nhanh dọc chân tường gỗ, giũ thảm chùi chân ngoài ban công rồi giặt sạch miếng bọt biển ẩm trước bữa trưa.

Nhờ hoàn thành đều đặn từng khu vực dọn dẹp nhỏ mỗi cuối tuần, không ai trong hai bạn còn phải đối mặt với mảng bám cứng đầu, ngày nắng trôi qua uổng phí hay cảnh kiệt sức vào Chủ nhật. Một danh sách đầu việc chia sẻ đơn giản biến công việc nhà hàng tuần mệt nhọc thành thói quen nhẹ nhàng, dễ đoán trước, giữ mọi căn phòng sáng sủa luôn thoáng sạch và dễ chịu.
pronunciationNotesVi: Từ "grime" (/ɡraɪm/) là từ một âm tiết chứa nguyên âm đôi /aɪ/ và âm cuối /m/ khép môi rõ.
Từ "lukewarm" (/ˈlukˌwɔrm/) có trọng âm chính rơi vào âm tiết đầu "luke", lưu ý phát âm đủ âm /k/ nối nhẹ sang /w/.
Từ "overheating" (/ˌoʊ.vɚˈhi.tɪŋ/) có trọng âm chính rơi vào âm tiết thứ ba "heat" (/hiː/), tránh nhấn nhầm vào "over".
Từ "pane" (/peɪn/) đồng âm với "pain", chứa nguyên âm đôi /eɪ/ và âm mũi /n/ rõ ở cuối.
Từ "microfiber" (/ˌmaɪ.kroʊˈfaɪ.bɚ/) nhấn trọng âm chính ở âm tiết thứ ba "fi", phát âm gọn hai nguyên âm đôi /aɪ/.

passages.title: Keeping Shared Kitchen Counters Fresh With Quick Micro-Habits
passages.text:
Waiting until Sunday afternoon to scrub dried red tomato splatters off stovetops often turns simple ten-minute kitchen chores into exhausting two-hour weekend marathons. Once sugary fruit drips and cooking oil mist bake tightly onto cool tile backsplashes or crusty ceramic sinks overnight, scrubbing hardened sticky spots requires heavy chemical sprays and tired aching wrists rather than light warm cotton cloths.

Adopting quick clean-as-you-go habits during evening meal preparation keeps busy shared apartments spotless effortlessly. Filling half of one deep sink basin with mild warm soapy water before chopping sweet onions creates a ready soak station for sticky cheese graters, sharp paring knives, and steel measuring spoons right after use. Wiping fine flour dust off wooden cutting boards promptly while baked trays cool on stovetop wire racks stops dry crumbs from scattering down hallway wool rugs afterward. Keeping one color-coded microfiber cloth strictly for dining tables and another clean square beside the espresso grinder prevents coffee grounds or buttery smears from wandering across crisp homework notebooks cleanly.

Respecting weekly kitchen appliance checkups keeps hidden moisture and stale food smells away silently all year round. Emptying fine sink mesh drain traps cleanly into compost pails every night stops pipe blockages before slow standing puddles gather around dishes. Wiping rubber fridge door gaskets with warm diluted vinegar water monthly lifts hidden moisture dots without scratching bright metal trim, while brushing stray toaster crumbs gently outside keeps morning sourdough toast smelling pure.

Sharing small daily reset routines fairly across household roommates transforms messy cleanup chores into quick pleasant teamwork every evening before warm dessert bowls even cool completely.
passages.textVi:
Đợi đến tận chiều Chủ Nhật mới cọ vết sốt cà chua đỏ khô cứng trên bếp thường biến việc dọn bếp mười phút đơn giản thành cuộc chạy đua cuối tuần kiệt sức suốt hai tiếng. Một khi giọt trái cây ngọt và hơi dầu mỡ kịp bám chặt qua đêm trên tường gạch ốp hay bồn rửa gốm, việc chà rửa các mảng dính đóng vảy đòi hỏi dung dịch tẩy mạnh cùng đôi cổ tay mỏi nhừ thay vì chỉ chiếc khăn cotton ấm nhẹ tay.

Áp dụng thói quen dọn gọn ngay trong lúc nấu ăn buổi tối giữ căn hộ ở chung luôn sạch bóng nhẹ nhàng. Xả sẵn nước ấm pha chút nước rửa dịu vào nửa bồn sâu trước khi thái hành tây ngọt tạo ngay trạm ngâm cho bàn nạo phô mai dính, dao gọt và thìa đong thép ngay sau khi dùng. Phủi gọn bụi bột bánh mì khỏi thớt gỗ trong lúc khay nướng đang nguội trên giá dây thép ngăn vụn khô rơi vãi khắp thảm len hành lang về sau. Phân biệt riêng một khăn sợi nhỏ cho bàn ăn và một khăn sạch cạnh máy xay cà phê giúp bã cà phê hay vệt bơ không bám sang vở học gọn gàng.

Kiểm tra nhanh thiết bị nhà bếp hằng tuần giúp ngăn hơi ẩm ẩn và mùi thức ăn cũ quanh năm. Đổ sạch giỏ lọc rác bồn rửa vào xô ủ phân mỗi tối chặn nghẽn đường ống trước khi nước đọng quanh chén bát. Lau vòng gioăng cao su cửa tủ lạnh mỗi tháng bằng khăn ấm pha chút giấm loãng lấy sạch đốm ẩm ẩn mà không làm xước viền kim loại sáng, còn phủi nhẹ vụn bánh trong khay máy nướng giúp bánh mì men chua buổi sáng luôn thơm tinh tươm.

Chia sẻ những thói quen thu dọn ngắn hằng ngày công bằng giữa bạn cùng nhà biến việc dọn rửa ngán ngẩm thành màn phối hợp nhẹ nhàng vui vẻ mỗi tối trước khi bát chè tráng miệng ấm kịp nguội.
pronunciationNotesVi: Danh từ "chores" (/tʃɔrz/) mở đầu bằng âm /tʃ/ (giống "chair"), TUYỆT ĐỐI KHÔNG đọc thành /kɔrz/ giống "chorus"!
Cụm "microfiber" (/ˌmaɪ.kroʊ.ˈfaɪ.bɚ/) giữ âm căng đôi /aɪ/ ở cả "mi-" lẫn "fi-", nhấn trọng âm chính vào âm tiết thứ ba "-fi-".
Từ "vinegar" (/ˈvɪ.nə.ɡɚ/) đọc ba âm tiết đều nhẹ nhàng với nguyên âm ngắn /ɪ/ ngay đầu ("vin-"), trọng âm rơi âm đầu tiên.
Trong "appliances" (/ə.ˈplaɪ.ən.sɪz/), trọng âm chính đặt vào âm tiết thứ hai "-pli-" rồi đọc lướt nhanh đuôi hai âm cuối.

Wooden cutting boards dissolve quickly when washed before breakfast

Tomatoes peel themselves faster before hitting cool ceramic tiles
Hallway wool rugs dry swiftly while bread trays cool near stoves
Coffee grounds turn into fresh compost dust overnight inside bowls

comprehensionQuestions.question: Why should rubber refrigerator door gaskets be wiped monthly with diluted vinegar water?
options: It removes hidden moisture dots safely without scratching metal trims
It makes glass homework notebooks shine cleanly under espresso lamps
It cools warm toaster crumb trays before bread melts onto counters
It doubles kitchen drain flow speed around greasy tomato pots
comprehensionQuestions.explanationVi: Đoạn ba giải thích lau gioăng tủ lạnh bằng nước giấm loãng giúp làm sạch đốm ẩm mốc ẩn mà không làm trầy viền kim loại.
